$comment: Output contract of the per-pleno review agents (arquitectura-agentes §3.1, F2.5). run_agents.py passes it to `claude -p --json-schema`, then turns each item into propose.py's input format and runs it through verify_proposals.py. entry_json is a JSON object serialised as a string: free-form objects fit structured output badly, and N7 + the verifier check its shape anyway.

subject.description: The intervention id, pleno id or entity id the proposal is about

title.description: One line, English, imperative or descriptive

message.description: Why, in English, for the PR reviewer

quote.description: Literal quote from the acta, in the acta's language, copied as-is (at least 4 words)

evidence_pleno.description: pleno_id of the acta the quote comes from

entry_json.description: The YAML entry as a JSON object, e.g. {"iv_id": "2026-07-23-005", "entitat": "…"}

notes.description: What you checked and found fine, or could not decide, in English
